title: Mixed Event — Let's Study Hard! — Episode5 Corridor Conversation

meta.Event Outline: The end of the year is approaching at Kamiyama High School. An is headed to practice as usual when a teacher stops her and Mizuki in their tracks. That's when the pair are confronted with some hair-raising news about their prospects for the next school year.

rows.Line: The next day - After school
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “And autumpne stirreth it most of al, oft it hath bin said.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Everyone says that things are most charming in fall...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Forsooth it may be so, yit nought can enflame the herte as can...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That may be true, but nothing is as moving as...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ooh, look at you, An!
You've come so far since yesterday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I guess. Well...
I do have to check the textbook for vocabulary and conjugations, but I'm getting there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I looked at my vocab list in the bath last night, but it was stressful since I couldn't really memorize much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well then!
I have an exciting present for such a hardworking student!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here you go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's...a notebook?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I made it last night. I put together a whole bunch of study notes like important words to learn and conjugation crib sheets.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow... You went to all this trouble for me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is...impressive.
Your notes are very clear and concise.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
They are, aren't they?!
Feel free to keep praising me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you really took it seriously. What brought that on so suddenly?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, rude.
I just want An not to get held back a year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An, I'm rooting for you to make it into second year armed with this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you, Mizuki! I'll make good use of it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes! I solved it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good work, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, how about we stop for a while? Breaks are important for maintaining concentration.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I've been getting thirsty, so I'll go grab a drink.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about rock paper scissors then? Loser buys for everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ooh, I like that! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's fine by me...
However, it will be a lot for one person, so how about the last two people go?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rock...paper...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Scissors!
Ten or so minutes later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't believe I lost...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not to mention how they all asked for snacks and other food on top of drinks, so the bags are stuffed to the brim.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I suppose they're just that tired. I could take your bag?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that's fine, Kamishiro!
You already took the heavier bag.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, are you fine carrying that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's no trouble.
I wouldn't want to tire you out since you need to save your energy for your studies.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha, you're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... Thank you, really.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Not just for carrying the bag...
For teaching us, too. You explain things so clearly, and it's all so helpful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me. I've been having fun myself with things being so lively.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Also... Mizuki seems to be having fun.
I certainly wasn't expecting that notebook.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was surprised too!
That was such a thoughtful gesture.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And yesterday, when I said thank you for helping us with studying, Mizuki just said, “Don't mention it!” and “It was fun.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Didn't the two of you go to the same junior high school?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Were you close back then too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd say so... We'd meet up and chat from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki seems to be having much more fun now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These study sessions are proof of that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I guess I only know the Mizuki we have right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it comes down to having friends who are good influences.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I believe you're one such friend, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think having friends like you is a big help for Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Friends like me...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... But I really haven't done anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, I just enjoy spending time with Mizuki, so I wanted to be friends!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I don't feel like I've done anything to help. Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If Mizuki is glad that we became friends, I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're back! And we bring drinks and snacks!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
About time, guys!
I'm starving here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry!
But we got the French fries you asked for.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh! At long last!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Got my cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes sirree. Is this the right one?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Tsukasa, Toya. Shiraishi has the food, and the drinks are in my bag.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it! Many thanks, Rui, Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see, this coffee is yours, right Toya? It's hot, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here's your orange juice, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Be sure to eat plenty and get ready to study more.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
